meta.notes: Blank SBA series outline for teachers/students to fill in. One portfolio = research workbook + four pieces (Artwork / Critical studies); at least one Artwork. Outline only — not a full guide field rewrite.
meta.exemplarsPolicy: Do not paste or paraphrase any high-score student exemplars or SBA sample scripts. Blank structure and prompt lines only.
meta.fillInHint: Leave all value / blank fields empty for the user to complete.

plannedArc.label: Four-piece progression plan (blank)
plannedArc.hint: One short line each for how pieces 1→4 develop.

portfolio.atLeastOneArtworkReminder: Reminder: at least one of the four pieces must be an Artwork.

rwbOutline.intro: Section prompts for the research workbook (outline only; full fields in sba-guide). Fill in yourself — do not copy exemplars.

sections.title: Idea development
prompts: Options A / B / C and notes (blank)

prompts: Next change and link to theme (blank)

prompts: First idea vs what I found (blank)

perPieceChecklist.intro: Short checklist before or while working on each piece (details in sba-guide).

items.label: Clear link from this piece to the theme
Media trial done (or note why skipped)
Process and final evidence in place
Type set: Artwork or Critical study

progressionNote.label: Series progression note
progressionNote.hint: From piece 2 onward, note how this piece improves on the last (skill, idea, media, critical depth, etc.).
progressionNote.piece1Note: Piece 1 opening: state your starting point and goal (no previous piece to compare).

howTo: Print or open the blank outline in the app; students fill four slots under one theme.
Lock theme and four-piece arc first, then set each type (Artwork / Critical study).
Research workbook follows Steps 1–6 prompts; use sba-guide for full fields.
Check: ≥1 Artwork; clear progression across four pieces — not four copies of one draft.
doNot: Do not paste or rewrite high-score student scripts / exemplar PDFs.
Do not add SEN or diagnosis labels.
Do not treat this file as a full guide field rewrite.
